title: Ikala character part
description: One swappable mesh: a body part that fills slots, a clothing or armor layer, or an accessory on a socket.

FxUse.description: An effect placed on a character: which effect, the bone or socket it follows, and tuning.

bone.description: The bone it follows, like "hand.R". Give a bone or a socket.

socket.description: The socket it follows, like "head_top". Give a bone or a socket.

offset.description: Its offset from the bone or socket, in meters, in the bone's space, up to 1.27 each way.

color.description: The palette channel that tints it, like "accent". Left out, it keeps the effect's own colors.

scale.description: Its size and speed, times the effect's, above 0 and up to 4.

rate.description: How many particles it spawns, times the effect's, 0 to 4.

intensity.description: How brightly it glows, times the effect's, 0 to 4.

when.description: When it shows: "always", "moving", "combat", or a toggle that gameplay or the player controls, like "wings". Lowercase words joined by dots, up to 32 letters.

name.description: The material's name in the mesh.

channels.description: Which palette channel each tint mask channel (r, g, b, a) takes, like {"r": "primary"}.

defaults.description: The color each tint mask channel shows when the design leaves its palette channel uncolored, like {"r": "#6b4a2f"}.

Part.description: One swappable mesh: a body part that fills slots, a clothing or armor layer, or an accessory on a socket.

plan.description: The body plan it is for.

kind.description: What sort of part it is.

fills.description: The body slots a body part fills, or the layers a layer part fills. Accessories leave it out.

fits.description: For accessories: the socket names or socket types it fits.

rigid.description: For accessories: whether it moves rigidly with its socket, like a hat.

extension.description: For skinned accessories: the extension chain it is weighted to, like "cape".

mirror.description: Whether it is authored for one side, and the converter makes the other by mirroring and swapping .L and .R.

meshes.description: Mesh assets by variant name, with "*" for any other variant.

materialSlots.description: The mesh's materials, and which palette channels tint them.

tags.description: Tags that variants and editors filter by, like "robot".

conflicts.description: Parts that can't be used along with this one.

requires.description: Parts that must be used along with this one.

hidesRegions.description: Mask regions of the body this hides, so they don't poke through.

hidesLayers.description: Layers this hides, like a helmet hiding hair.

sockets.description: Sockets this moves, for stumps and missing limbs, so held items still have somewhere to go.

fx.description: Effects it carries, like sparks on a robot arm, gone when it is swapped.

placement.description: For accessories: where it sits on its socket, by variant name with "*" for any other variant, moved from where its mesh puts it.

extends.description: The ID of a definition of the same kind to start from. Fields written here replace the parent's, and objects merge field by field.

Placement.description: Where an accessory sits on its socket, moved from where its mesh puts it.

offset.description: How far it moves, in meters: x across, y up, z forward.

rotate.description: How it turns about the x, y and z axes through its socket, in degrees, in that order.

scale.description: How much it grows about its socket.

offset.description: Its offset from the bone, in meters.

rotate.description: Its rotation from the bone, in degrees.
